name: desktop-startup-gating
title: Desktop startup gating
description: Tighten desktop startup gating so the main window appears as soon as the HTML startup shell can safely take over, while first-interaction readiness remains gated by explicit startup signals instead of duplicate waits.
creator: claude-agent
notes: Core rule: show the native loading window only until the hidden main window plus HTML startup shell can take over. Keep SQLite migration gating, remove duplicate desktop-local blocking health waits, and do not let home-page warm prefetch delay startup-interactive.
